description:

*Sat Oct 24* anytime daytime Wide-open Saturday — no game, no plans. Best 
of the bunch
*Tue Oct 27* evening, 5:30–8pm Clean weeknight, well clear of travel
*Tue Nov 10* evening, 5:30–8pm Fully open, home
*Sat Nov 14* anytime daytime Another wide-open Saturday — no game

four: *Oct 9, Oct 24, Nov 10, Nov 14.*

   Henry's morning game and an evening Spirit broadcast. 
   - *Fri Oct 30* evening — open (just the night before Halloween). 
   - *Sat Nov 7* — late morning or after ~2:30pm (Henry has a 1pm game). 

Weeks to avoid 
   
   - *Sep 28–30* and *Oct 11–16* and *Oct 20–21* and *Nov 2–5* — you're in 
   Boston. 
   - *Oct 6 evening* — night before your Oct 7 early-morning appointment. 
   - *Oct 23* (Atsuko Okatsuka show) and *Nov 13* (Book Club) evenings. 
   - *Nov 22–29* — the "Vermont?" week / Thanksgiving. 
   - Henry has soccer *Mon/Wed/Thu evenings* through ~Nov 19, so those 
   weeknights are out. (Tuesdays/Fridays are clear — assuming no baseball gets 
   added back to his schedule.)

title: Re: Capital One: what is management not saying?
description:
Esther - you know the real story. You actually worked at Capital One.

Every earnings call, management explains what the quarter means. Once you join our panel, we'll ask you how what they say matches with what you saw.

We'll ask you questions that are tailored to you based on your prior roles, and your answers will make sure the right story is being told.

Question examples include:

 * Management explains why something happened. You know whether that's how it actually works. 
   
   
 * A metric went up. You know what's actually inside it, and whether it proves what they're claiming. 
   
   
 * They've promised something by a date. You know where the real bottleneck is, and how long it takes. 
   
   
 * The key numbers to watch, and what they mean when they change.


In return is not only compensation but also the final report itself (plus those for related companies).

Let me know if I can reserve your spot to speak. As always, these are completely anonymized and your identity is protected.

Lydia Dellere
Sales Associate
Heron Intelligence (formerly Blue Heron Research Partners)
New York | London
ldellere@geteventsheron.com
